```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Finite-mixture labels are not identifiable: permuting every component label
leaves the likelihood unchanged. Raw component-wise posterior means can
therefore be meaningless unless draws or starts are aligned to a documented
reference. Co-clustering probabilities are invariant to permutations.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(VariationalBayesHLRM)

simulation <- simulate_data(
  conditional_dgp(chlrm_model(2, 2), list(
    component_coefficients = rbind(c(0, 1), c(2, -1)),
    component_variances = c(0.5, 0.5),
    mixture_weights = c(0.5, 0.5)
  )),
  simulation_design("independent_normal"),
  simulation_sample(group_count = 12, observations_per_group = 15),
  seed = 401
)

prior <- chlrm_prior(
  c(0, 0), 10 * diag(2),
  coefficient_dispersion_df = 4,
  coefficient_dispersion_scale = diag(2),
  residual_degrees_of_freedom = 4,
  residual_variance_scale_shape = 2,
  residual_variance_scale_rate = 2,
  mixture_concentration = c(1, 1)
)

fit <- fit_model(
  chlrm_model(2, 2), simulation$train, prior, "cavi",
  initialization_kmeans(),
  cavi_control(max_iterations = 2000, starts = 5),
  seed = 402, verbose = FALSE
)

reference <- fit_orchestration(fit)$label_reference
aligned_fit <- relabel_fit(fit, reference)

components(aligned_fit)
responsibilities(aligned_fit)
classify_groups(aligned_fit)
classification_uncertainty(aligned_fit)
co_clustering(aligned_fit)
plot(aligned_fit, type = "responsibilities")
```

`relabel_fit()` is a pure transformation: it leaves `fit` unchanged and applies
the same reference to component parameters, latent allocations, posterior
draws, summaries, and accessors. A reference can therefore be learned from a
multichain MCMC fit and reused for CAVI and SVI fits with compatible dimensions
and scaling coordinates. Classification uncertainty quantifies posterior
ambiguity and should accompany hard labels. The co-clustering matrix answers
whether pairs of groups belong to the same component and remains interpretable
even when component names are arbitrary.
